title: Job Application Pipeline - job fit score breakdown
description: Written by /js-scan, one per job posting. Deliberately stores the full reasoning, not just the number: the dashboard shows why a job scored what it did, and the prep report reuses matched requirements as 'aligned with your profile' and unmatched ones as 'potential gaps'.

score.description: coverage_weight * coverage_pct + depth_weight * depth_pct, using the weights in scoring-config.json.

tier.description: Label from scoring-config.json's tier_bands, e.g. Strong/Possible/Weak.

prioritized.description: score >= prioritized_threshold, unless overridden. A prioritized job gets full CV/cover-letter/prep-report generation; others are saved with their posting and score only.

override.description: Set when the candidate flips this job's flag in the dashboard, so a re-scan doesn't silently undo their decision.

coverage_pct.description: Weighted fraction of the posting's requirements matched, required items counting required_multiplier and nice-to-haves nice_to_have_multiplier.

depth_pct.description: Average of (confidence_1_10/10 * axis weight, normalized against the candidate's highest axis weight) across matched requirements only. 0 when nothing matched.

requirement.description: The requirement as the posting words it.

required.description: true = must-have per the posting's own language; false = nice-to-have.

skill_key.description: The matching skill in experience.json. All experiences sharing this key count as evidence for this one requirement.

confidence_1_10.description: Highest confidence among the entries sharing this skill_key.

unmatched_requirements.description: Requirements with no honest match in experience.json. These become the prep report's 'potential gaps' - never quietly dropped.

note.description: Optional: why it didn't match, e.g. 'adjacent to his ROS1 work but not the same tool'.
